note: What each province, city and municipality’s treasurer reported collecting and spending, in pesos, to the Bureau of Local Government Finance — actuals, not the budget the council appropriated. Each unit’s year is a row of numbers in the order of "fields". Debt is the flow in a year: loans and bonds taken, interest paid, principal repaid; no public source gives a per-LGU outstanding balance. A year left out is a year the LGU did not file (zero operating income); inside a filed year a zero is a zero. FY 2025 is BLGF’s preliminary release and some rows are part-year. Barangays have no SRE: their money is not here. Sulu, in BARMM until 2024, is left out. Maguindanao’s province rows before its 2022 split are under "former"; its towns sit under the province they are in now. The eight Special Geographic Area towns, created in 2024, have no SRE rows yet. No per-LGU figure for FY 2026 is published yet.
